Title: Sanjay's Day

Cast

1. Sanjay - 30 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Ajay - 27 years, friend
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
3. Kavita - 27 years, friend
Look: green saree

Places

1. The forest - tall trees, thick bushes

Scene 1: The forest - Day

[Sanjay stands in the forest. Kavita stands near him.]

Kavita: "What lovely weather!"

[Sanjay goes hunting and aims his bow at a deer.]

Sanjay: "Well done!"

[Sanjay rides an elephant through the forest.]

Kavita: "What a day to remember!"
